A quorum of the City Council may be present at this meeting. While no formal votes or actions are anticipated by the City Council, members may participate in the discussion of topics listed on this agenda. This notice is filed to ensure compliance with the Open Meeting Law should a quorum of the parent body be present.

Roll Call

Chair Sica called the meeting to order at 5:36 PM

Also in attendance was Compliance Officers Dave Morse and Jim Tuxbury, and Assistant City Clerk Morgan Hunte and Bianca Stallworth of the City Clerk's Office.

Present: 4 - Jadeane Sica, Paul Condon, Karen Colon Hayes and Ari Taylor

Absent: 1 - Chris Simonelli

Minutes to be Approved

**329-26** 

Minutes for the meeting of May 12, 2026

A motion was made by Councillor Condon, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that the Committee Minutes be approved. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

Business

The Compliance Officers and Asst. City Clerk Hunte confirmed there were no issues with any of the following petitions.

**273-26** 

Petition: Open-Air Parking Lot: AGM Auto Sales, Inc., 135 Eastern Avenue, Malden, 28 spaces (Renewal)

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor Taylor, that the Petition be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

**274-26** 

Petition: Pool Tables: Top Pools, Inc., 77 Exchange Street, Malden, 7 tables (New)

headline: Recommended seven license and parking petitions favorably to the City Council by unanimous votes.
summary: The License Committee reviewed petitions for an open-air parking lot, pool tables, extended hours, a livery company, a livery driver, and two outdoor parking lots. Compliance officers and the Assistant City Clerk confirmed no issues with any petition, and the committee voted unanimously to recommend each one favorably to the City Council. The committee also approved the minutes of its May 12, 2026 meeting by unanimous vote.
decisions: Recommended Petition 273-26 (Open-Air Parking Lot: AGM Auto Sales, Inc., 135 Eastern Avenue, Malden, 28 spaces, Renewal) favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
Recommended Petition 274-26 (Pool Tables: Top Pools, Inc., 77 Exchange Street, Malden, 7 tables, New) favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
Recommended Petition 311-26 (Extended Hours: El Mexsal, 97 Medford Street, Malden, Hours: 7 Days, 6am-1am, New) favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
Recommended Petition 312-26 (Livery Company: Luxury Fleet, LLC, 9 Constance Street, Malden, 1 Vehicle, New) favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
Recommended Petition 313-26 (Livery Driver: Ankush Kumar, 9 Constance Street, Malden, New) favorably by unanimous vote.
Recommended Petition 314-26 (Outdoor Parking: United Properties Inc., 25 Florence Street, Malden, 34 spaces, Renewal) favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
Recommended Petition 315-26 (Outdoor Parking: United Properties Inc., 29 Madison Street, Malden, 40 spaces, Renewal) favorably to the City Council by unanimous vote.
